reason: A CLI plugin for managing remote dsh web instances through SSH, including remote port allocation, systemd supervision, resilient local tunnels, lifecycle commands, logs, and audits.

summaries.zh: 通过 SSH 管理远程 dsh Web 实例，提供远程端口分配、systemd 服务监管、可重连本地隧道及状态与日志操作。
summaries.en: Manage remote dsh web instances over SSH with remote port allocation, systemd supervision, reconnecting local tunnels, and lifecycle, status, and log commands.

capabilities: Connects to configured remote hosts over SSH
Creates and manages remote systemd services
Maintains resilient local SSH tunnels with automatic reconnection
Reads remote service logs and performs port-registry audits
Optionally bootstraps Node, dsh, and related remote configuration
